description: This file is a PHP script that outputs JavaScript functions for number formatting, including functions to format numbers with delimiters, remove decimal delimiters, and convert formatted strings to floats. It also includes setup for localization and constants.

methods.name: max_formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number (or string) with thousand and decimal delimiters.

methods.name: max_formatNumberIgnoreDecimals
methods.description: Removes decimal delimiters from a number and formats with thousand delimiters.

methods.name: max_baseFormatNumber
methods.description: Inserts thousand and decimal separators into a number for display.

methods.name: max_formattedNumberStringToFloat
methods.description: Converts a formatted number string into a float, removing delimiters.
